highlights_headline: The unreleased 4.159.0 changes improve mask-filtered glyph rendering and handle specific Vulkan allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

bullets.detail: When successive loads from a stateful font scaler disagree about a glyph's path, format, or bounds, rendering now uses the reloaded glyph and clears incompatible masks instead of overflowing sub-byte rows. Clipped embossed glyphs also use full plane strides when copying mask data.

Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after descriptor-set allocation reports host or device out-of-memory on Imagination drivers, avoiding a driver failure during pool destruction. Graphite also prevents further allocation through the abandoned handle; other vendors and allocation errors are unaffected by this workaround.
